samples.evidence: docs/tasks/active/20260904-class-b-backend-endpoints-todo.md lines 25-49 list steps 2-9 (comment-ops.ts/comments.controller.ts, slide-ops.ts/slides.controller.ts, tab-ops.ts, worksheet-images.ts, board-tree.ts, CLI commands) as unchecked '[ ]'. However packages/backend/src/yorkie/comment-ops.ts, packages/backend/src/api/v1/comments.controller.ts, packages/backend/src/yorkie/slide-ops.ts, packages/backend/src/api/v1/slides.controller.ts, packages/backend/src/yorkie/tab-ops.ts, packages/backend/src/yorkie/worksheet-images.ts, packages/backend/src/api/v1/worksheet-images.controller.ts, packages/backend/src/yorkie/board-tree.ts, and packages/cli/src/commands/comments.ts already exist and implement exactly the features described (including the toYorkieMs/fromYorkieMs helpers the lessons file specifically describes), which contradicts the checklist's implication that this work is still pending.
